completion:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a successful industrial safety audit

3. Compose your analysis.
4. List all relevant observations from the inspection records.
5. Mention any equipment or protocols that were not followed.
6. Reference any industry standards or guidelines that were violated.
7. Include any necessary technical details.
8. Express your analysis in clear language.
9. Include citations for any statistics or data.
10. Present your analysis using a neutral, professional tone.
11. Submit your analysis on time.
